mapper.select: SELECT id, generation_job_id, user_id, reserved_credits, actual_credits, status, allocations, catalog_version, discount_bp, rule_snapshot, title, release_note, gmt_create, gmt_modified, version FROM billing_cost_reservations WHERE generation_job_id = #{jobId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE billing_cost_reservations SET status = 'settled', actual_credits = #{actualCredits}, version = version + 1 WHERE generation_job_id = #{jobId}
UPDATE billing_cost_reservations SET status = 'released', actual_credits = 0, release_note = #{releaseNote}, version = version + 1 WHERE generation_job_id = #{jobId}
